scope: Pinned single-player shared-mechanism regression and mandatory semantic boundaries; only authorized two enemy bans. Visible Steam gameplay and full-run validation remain separate requirements.
policy: Execute a primary effect witness for every reviewed mechanism family and the explicit cross-family/guard boundaries below on one adapter binary. The wider fixture library retains tier and parameter variants and historical failures; those are development evidence, not mandatory repeated release inputs. Original pinned callbacks, command ownership, complete snapshots, fork/key/stamp/RNG, unknown callback guards and UI/full-run gates remain required. A listed cross-family regression alone does not count as a primary family witness.

basic-player-scalar-and-turn.reason: Audit of the early direct mirrors: owner attribution, damage/block/heal coefficients and caps, HP/relic scaling, saved counters, turn boundaries, X costs and temporary powers. These are not covered merely by later native callback families.

basic-player-damage-and-card-body.reason: Actual damage-result and block/HP boundaries, Artifact proc state, hidden temporary powers, custom WhiteHole/BladeWaltz/QuantumComputing card bodies and slow/corrosion commands require explicit early witnesses.

basic-card-upgrade-and-result.reason: Conditional patched vanilla card bodies, repeat/result placement, counters/reset, generated hand capacity, transformation RNG and captured acquisition-only runes.

basic-enemy-scalar-and-hit.reason: Shared enemy coefficients/startup/spawn/revival and real HP loss/proc/Artifact transitions with branch-owned modifier state.

basic-enemy-card-flow.reason: Enemy returned-card, energy payment/X and per-turn counts plus native slow dispatch and strongest repeated-attack tier.
